_about: PerfFlags.cs / FxPrewarm.cs. verboseLogs=false skips per-frame diagnostic Debug.Log lines (ArmHold, FootGround, FootYaw, finisher piece/look chatter); set true for a proof run that needs them. logStackTrace none|scriptOnly|full ('' = leave Unity's default) applies to Log + Warning only. prewarm=true renders every FX material once, sub-pixel small, prewarmDelaySeconds after the scene loads. fxScanPerFrame = renderers FxMaterialGuard checks per frame. prewarmInHarness=false keeps FxPrewarm off in proof/balance/finisher-auto/steer-auto runs.
